text:
CalWORKs (California Work Opportunity and Responsibility to Kids) — Alameda County Social Services Agency, via 211 Alameda County resource listing.

Provides temporary cash assistance for low-income families with children, up to 60 months. Eligibility: families must meet income and asset tests; children must be deprived of parental support due to incapacity, death, absence, or unemployment of a parent; considers citizenship/immigration status, age, income, resources, and assets; children covered to age 18. Maximum Aid Payment examples: family of 1: $807; 2: $1,036; 3: $1,310; 4: $1,574; 5: $1,844; 6: $2,117.

Apply or renew at BenefitsCal.com. Phone: 888-999-4772 (main), 510-272-3663 (alternate). No fee. Documents: photo ID, proof of income, citizenship/legal immigration status information, Social Security number, work or school status. Interpreter services available. Coverage: Alameda County.

Medi-Cal — Alameda County Social Services Agency, via 211 Alameda County resource listing (local health plan provider: Partnership HealthPlan).

Public health care coverage for low-income California residents: medical, dental, and vision. Covers low-income individuals, families with children, seniors, persons with disabilities, foster care, pregnant women, and individuals with conditions such as tuberculosis, breast cancer, or HIV. Income limits: 138% of the Federal Poverty Level for adults, 266% for children, 213% for pregnant women. Beginning January 1, 2024, adults ages 26–49 may qualify for full-scope Medi-Cal regardless of immigration status; all other eligibility rules still apply.

Apply: call 800-698-1118 (application request line) or 510-272-3663, visit the website, visit during program hours, or mail a paper application. No fee. Documents: proof of income (pay stubs, Social Security award letter, child support/alimony, unemployment/disability stubs, veteran benefits); proof of residency (rent/mortgage receipt or utility bill); may also be asked for resource statements, checking/savings accounts, vehicle registration, and proof of ID. Interpreter services available. Coverage: Alameda County.
